description: Land Acquisition - Pallepamunuwa, Aranayaka D/S Division, Kegalle District - Podape, Aranayaka D/S Division, Kegalle District - Amended Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2078/03 dated 02.07.2018, Horowpathana D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired, their boundaries, extents, and the process for interested parties to claim compensation. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns government acquisition of land for public purposes.
